entities.summary: Rex Andrew Sinquefield is an American businessman, investor, and philanthropist who has been called an 'index-fund pioneer' for contributing to the early development and popularization of passively managed index funds among retail investors. Sinquefield was also a co-founder of Dimensional Fund Advisors. A member of the Republican Party, he is active in Missouri politics.
